questions_and_answers.question: Description 1: 'Watakushi no mae ni depaato ga arimasu. Hidari ni kooshuu denwa ga arimasu.' Which numbered location on the map matches this description?
Description 2: 'Watakushi no ushiro ni shingoo ga arimasu. Migi ni kooban ga arimasu.' Which numbered location on the map matches this description?
Description 3: 'Watakushi no mae ni gakkoo ga arimasu. Watakushi no hidari ni shingoo ga arimasu.' Which numbered location on the map matches this description?
Description 4: 'Watakushi no migi wa eki desu. Mae ni resutoran ga arimasu.' Which numbered location on the map matches this description?
Description 5: 'Mukoo ni kooban ga arimasu. Watakushi no mae ni kissaten ga arimasu.' Which numbered location on the map matches this description?

articles.text: Directions: Read the following and then select the number of the location on the map that matches its description below.
1. Watakushi no mae ni depaato ga arimasu. Hidari ni kooshuu denwa ga arimasu.
(In front of me there is a department store. On the left there is a public phone.)
2. Watakushi no ushiro ni shingoo ga arimasu. Migi ni kooban ga arimasu.
(Behind me there is a traffic light. On the right there is a police box.)
3. Watakushi no mae ni gakkoo ga arimasu. Watakushi no hidari ni shingoo ga arimasu.
(In front of me there is a school. On my left there is a traffic light.)
4. Watakushi no migi wa eki desu. Mae ni resutoran ga arimasu.
(On my right is the station. In front there is a restaurant.)
5. Mukoo ni kooban ga arimasu. Watakushi no mae ni kissaten ga arimasu.
(Beyond there is a police box. In front of me there is a coffee shop.)
Note: shingoo (⊕) = traffic light; gakkoo = school.
